# vyos.blueprints.mpls_ldp

MPLS with LDP

- Enables MPLS forwarding and LDP on core interfaces, with the LDP router-id and IPv4 transport address (usually the loopback).
- Building block for "L3VPN for Hub-and-Spoke connectivity with VyOS".
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no MPLS module. MPLS forwarding needs the kernel MPLS modules.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.mpls_ldp
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mpls_ldp_router_id` | str |  | `''` | LDP router-id. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `mpls_ldp_transport_address` | str |  | `''` | LDP IPv4 transport address; defaults to the router-id. |
| `mpls_ldp_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Core interfaces to run MPLS and LDP on. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks that LDP has at least one OPERATIONAL neighbour.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mpls_ldp_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
